title: Route guard-dependent and/or conditions to the short-circuit article
summary: The performance review now directs developers to the short-circuit article when guard conditions use operators like and/or with operands that depend on the guard, such as divisions or field reads that could be unsafe without the guard.
key_points: Adds a targeted cue to the performance review to identify guard-dependent and/or conditions
Routes developers to the boolean-operators-do-not-short-circuit article for patterns that depend on guard evaluation
Excludes conditions with independently safe operands to keep examples clean
Improves article selection from 0% to 100% of test cases with the fix
Validation passes for 292 test cases across review fixtures and contracts
